import gc
import os
import tempfile
import warnings

import click
from click.shell_completion import ShellComplete


@click.command()
@click.option("--config", type=click.File("r"))
def cli(config):
    pass


def check(name, args, incomplete):
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        f.write("data")
    try:
        comp = ShellComplete(cli, {}, "cli", "_CLICK_COMPLETE")
        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
            warnings.simplefilter("always")
            comp.get_completions(args, incomplete)
            gc.collect()
        resource_warnings = [x for x in w if issubclass(x.category, ResourceWarning)]
        status = "LEAK" if resource_warnings else "OK"
        print(f"{status}: {name} args={args} incomplete={incomplete!r}")
        for x in resource_warnings:
            print(f"    {x.category.__name__}: {x.message}")
    finally:
        os.remove(path)


# Complete a trailing arg after a File option already has a value.
check("file option has value, complete trailing", ["--config", "x.json"], "")
# Group case
grp = click.Group("grp", commands={})


@grp.command()
@click.option("--config", type=click.File("r"))
def sub(config):
    pass


fd, path2 = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
try:
    comp = ShellComplete(grp, {}, "grp", "_CLICK_COMPLETE")
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        comp.get_completions(["sub", "--config", path2], "")
        gc.collect()
    resource_warnings = [x for x in w if issubclass(x.category, ResourceWarning)]
    status = "LEAK" if resource_warnings else "OK"
    print(f"{status}: group sub file option args=['sub','--config',...]")
    for x in resource_warnings:
        print(f"    {x.category.__name__}: {x.message}")
finally:
    os.remove(path2)

print("DONE")

import gc
import os
import tempfile
import warnings

import click
from click.shell_completion import ShellComplete


@click.command()
@click.option("--config", type=click.File("r"))
def cli(config):
    pass


def run(name, cli_obj, args, incomplete):
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".json")
    os.close(fd)
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        f.write("data")
    try:
        # Use the REAL existing path as the option value so File.convert opens it.
        real_args = [a if a == "__PATH__" else a for a in args]
        comp = ShellComplete(cli_obj, {}, cli_obj.name, "_CLICK_COMPLETE")
        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
            warnings.simplefilter("always")
            comp.get_completions(real_args, incomplete)
            gc.collect()
        rw = [x for x in w if issubclass(x.category, ResourceWarning)]
        status = "LEAK" if rw else "OK"
        print(f"{status}: {name} args={real_args} incomplete={incomplete!r}")
        for x in rw:
            print(f"    {x.category.__name__}: {x.message}")
    finally:
        os.remove(path)
    return path


# Complete a trailing arg after a File option already has a value (the value
# is the real existing temp file path).
p = run("plain cmd, file opt has value", cli, ["--config", "__PATH__"], "")

grp = click.Group("grp")


@grp.command()
@click.option("--config", type=click.File("r"))
def sub(config):
    pass


def run_group(name, cli_obj, args, incomplete):
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".json")
    os.close(fd)
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        f.write("data")
    try:
        real_args = [a if a != "__PATH__" else path for a in args]
        comp = ShellComplete(cli_obj, {}, cli_obj.name, "_CLICK_COMPLETE")
        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
            warnings.simplefilter("always")
            comp.get_completions(real_args, incomplete)
            gc.collect()
        rw = [x for x in w if issubclass(x.category, ResourceWarning)]
        status = "LEAK" if rw else "OK"
        print(f"{status}: {name} args={real_args} incomplete={incomplete!r}")
        for x in rw:
            print(f"    {x.category.__name__}: {x.message}")
    finally:
        os.remove(path)


run_group("group sub, file opt has value", grp, ["sub", "--config", "__PATH__"], "")
print("DONE")

import gc
import os
import tempfile
import warnings

import click
from click.shell_completion import ShellComplete


@click.command()
@click.option("--config", type=click.File("r"))
@click.option("--data")
def cli(config, data):
    pass


grp = click.Group("grp")


@grp.command()
@click.option("--config", type=click.File("r"))
def sub(config):
    pass


# Chained group with File option
chain_grp = click.Group("chain", chain=True)


@chain_grp.command()
@click.option("--config", type=click.File("r"))
def setc(config):
    pass


@chain_grp.command()
def start():
    pass


def run(name, cli_obj, args_template, incomplete):
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".json")
    os.close(fd)
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        f.write("data")
    try:
        real_args = [path if a == "PATH" else a for a in args_template]
        comp = ShellComplete(cli_obj, {}, cli_obj.name, "_CLICK_COMPLETE")
        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
            warnings.simplefilter("always")
            result = comp.get_completions(real_args, incomplete)
            gc.collect()
        rw = [x for x in w if issubclass(x.category, ResourceWarning)]
        status = "LEAK" if rw else "OK"
        print(f"{status}: {name} args={real_args} incomplete={incomplete!r} result={result}")
        for x in rw:
            print(f"    {x.category.__name__}: {x.message}")
    finally:
        os.remove(path)


# 1. Plain command, File opt already has value, complete trailing option
run("plain: file has value, complete trailing", cli, ["--config", "PATH"], "--")
# 2. Plain command, complete the File opt's value itself (most common)
run("plain: completing file value", cli, ["--config", "PARTIAL"], "")
# 3. Group subcommand with File opt value
run("group: file has value", grp, ["sub", "--config", "PATH"], "")
# 4. Chained group, first cmd has File value, complete second
run("chained: file has value", chain_grp, ["setc", "--config", "PATH"], "")
# 5. Chained group, completing a value in second cmd position
run("chained: completing second", chain_grp, ["setc", "--config", "PATH", "start"], "")
print("DONE")
